name: Ktube Media Downloader
tagline: Browse and download multimedia videos and audio with ease
description: Ktube Media Downloader is a desktop application by Keshav Bhatt for browsing, streaming, and downloading video and audio from popular media websites. Features include multi-threaded downloads, queueing, audio extraction (MP3), and playlist management.
features: Multi-threaded downloading engine with bandwidth rate limiting
Extract pristine audio tracks directly to MP3, AAC, and FLAC formats
Batch download entire channels, playlists, and user collections
Built-in video preview player and resolution selector up to 4K
